After the check a “Verified” badge shows and the wizard moves on (Owner step only if the record names no owner, else Address); fields filled from the record carry “✓ Verified from GST/PAN”.

2. Enter the expired code and click Verify GSTIN

wording.old: NOSUCH99: “Referral code NOSUCH99 does not exist” with “Check the code, or request one”. Expired: “… expired on <date>”. Mandatory and empty: “Enter your referral code, or request one.”; Verify stays disabled until the code has at least 3 characters. The “Request a referral code” link shows while the field is empty or in error.
wording.new: NOSUCH99: “Referral code NOSUCH99 does not exist. Check the code, or request one.” (code mandatory) or “… Check the code, or leave it empty.” (code optional), with “Referral code NOSUCH99 does not exist.” under the field; the GSTIN is not checked. Expired: “Referral code <code> expired on <YYYY-MM-DD>. Check the code, …”. Mandatory: the field is labelled “Referral code” (no “(optional)”) and Verify GSTIN stays disabled while the code is empty or under 3 characters, so the screen never sends an empty code (the server refuses one with “Enter your referral code, or request one.”). The “Request a referral code” link (after “Don't have a referral code?”) shows while the field is empty or in error.
wording.why: The message's tail follows the setting (“request one” only when mandatory); the date is ISO; the empty-code message is the server's and cannot appear on the screen because Verify is disabled.

The blurred photo's row shows “Couldn't read — type it” (and “Choose which document this is.” when the document was not recognised); the GST number / PAN field stays unchanged.

wording.old:
1. With the provider unreachable, verify a GSTIN
2. Check the shop draft status in admin
wording.new:

wording.old: Owner sees “The government service is not answering right now. Please try again in a few minutes.” and cannot continue (DI-02). The check is PENDING with an error code, never FAILED.
wording.new: Owner sees “The government service is not answering right now. Please try again in a few minutes.” with the badge “Not verified yet”, no Continue button, and stays on “Verify your business” (DI-02). The stored check is PENDING with an error code (e.g. vendor_timeout), never FAILED.
wording.why: Add the badge and what “cannot continue” looks like; the error code is a vendor_* code.

wording.old: Not found: “This number was not found in the government record…”. Each other status shows its own message and the owner cannot continue with that number.
wording.new: Not found: “This number was not found in the government record. Please check it and try again.” Cancelled: “The government record shows this GSTIN as cancelled.” Suspended: “The government record shows this GSTIN as suspended.” Inactive: “The government record shows this number as inactive.” Each with the badge “Not verified”; the owner cannot continue with that number.
wording.why: Quote the real messages and the badge.

wording.old:
1. Verify the GSTIN
2. Continue the wizard
3. As admin, open the shop in the verification queue
wording.new:
1. Verify the GSTIN
2. Continue the wizard to the Payment step and click “Create my shop and pay”
3. As admin, open Seller verification review (/admin/seller-verification)

wording.old: Owner sees “We couldn't confirm this automatically. You can carry on — our team will check it.” and can continue; the shop is listed for review in admin.
wording.new: The wizard moves on and the next step shows a warning with the PAN's reason: “The name on the PAN does not match the name on the GST record. We'll check it by hand.” (name mismatch), “The government record gave no name. We'll check it by hand.”, “The government service is not answering right now. You can carry on — we'll keep checking.” (PAN service down) or “We couldn't confirm this automatically. You can carry on — our team will check it.” (any other review). The Payment step still says “Your GSTIN is verified: your shop goes live as soon as the payment is confirmed.” Once the shop is created, a PAN under review is listed in Seller verification review with Approve / Ask for more info / Reject (a PAN still waiting for the service is retried automatically and is not listed). A PAN the government refuses (inactive, expired) stops the owner on the identity step instead.
wording.why: The warning depends on why the PAN was not confirmed; the verified GSTIN alone decides go-live; the admin queue lists MANUAL_REVIEW (and config-paused) documents only.

wording.old:
1. Add a Udyam, an FSSAI and a Shop Act number in the shop documents
2. As admin, open the documents queue
wording.new:
1. On Shop verification (/shop/verification) enter a Udyam, an FSSAI and a Shop Act number (the Shop Act card also asks for the certificate or Form G receipt), tick the consent and click Verify on each
2. As admin, open Seller verification review (/admin/seller-verification)

wording.old: Each shows as under review (manual), never Failed; admin can approve or reject each.
wording.new: Each card on Shop verification shows “Under review” with “This document can't be checked online. Our team will review it.” (Sandbox.co.in checks only PAN and GSTIN), never “Not verified”; Seller verification review lists each with Approve, Ask for more info and Reject (a reason of at least 3 characters to reject or ask); an approved one becomes Verified, a rejected one Not verified.

Who owns or runs the shop?” when the record gives no business name); with “A” Continue stays disabled (the server refuses a one-letter name with “Enter the owner's name.”); a full name continues to “Confirm your shop address”. With an owner on record (a proprietor's PAN) the step is skipped.

wording.new: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A GSTIN that the staging KYC provider verifies (agreed with the owner; never a real person's number). Pay with Cashfree sandbox test data (UPI testsuccess@gocash) or, when PAYMENT_GATEWAY=SANDBOX, the built-in page “Pay (success)”. wording.old:

2. Read the registration date in Seller Central and in admin
wording.new:

wording.old: Both show today's IST date (e.g. a shop created 02.14 IST on 15-Nov shows 15/11/2026), not the UTC date.
wording.new: Both show today's IST date (e.g. a shop created 02.14 IST on 15-Nov shows 15/11/2026 in Seller Central and 2026-11-15 in the record; a day below 10 has no leading zero, e.g. 5/11/2026), not the UTC date.
wording.why: Seller Central formats with toLocaleDateString("en-IN") (d/m/yyyy); the record holds the ISO date.

wording.old:
1. Register with that GSTIN
2. Pay the fee
3. As admin, open the approval queue
wording.new:
1. On “Verify your business” enter that GSTIN (or, with “I don't have GST, use PAN”, its PAN), tick the consent and press “Verify GSTIN”
2. Race variant: verify a GSTIN no shop has yet, let another test account register and pay a shop with it, then finish your registration (another name / PIN) and pay the fee
3. As admin, open Shops → Instant approvals (Waiting)
wording.why: A GSTIN / PAN already on another account's shop is refused at the Verify step, before any paid check, so the owner never reaches payment; the 'held after payment' outcome only happens when the other shop takes the number after this owner verified it.

wording.old: Owner sees “A shop with this GSTIN is already registered on GoKesari by another account.” with the other shop's state (“It is live on GoKesari.” / “It is waiting for its registration fee or admin approval.” / “It is registered but not active at the moment.”) and “If it is yours, sign in with the account that registered it, or contact support.” After payment: “Payment received — pending admin approval”. Admin sees it held.
wording.new: Step 1 is refused before any government check: the alert “A shop with this GSTIN is already registered on GoKesari by another account. <state> If it is yours, sign in with the account that registered it, or contact support.”, where <state> is “It is live on GoKesari.” / “It is waiting for its registration fee or admin approval.” / “It is registered but not active at the moment.”, and the GSTIN field “This GSTIN is already registered.” (PAN route: “A shop with this PAN is already registered on GoKesari by another account. …”, field “This PAN is already registered.”). The owner cannot go on, so no shop is created and nothing is paid. Race variant: after payment “Payment received — pending admin approval” — “<shop> is pending admin approval. We'll email you as soon as your shop is live.”; the shop stays PENDING_APPROVAL and Instant approvals lists it “waiting for admin” — “Why waiting: likely duplicate of another shop (gstin, pan)”.
wording.why: The refusal now comes at Verify (owner brief 08-Nov-2026); 'Payment received — pending admin approval' is the race variant only. Admin's place is Shops → Instant approvals.

wording.old: Signed in as an owner who already has shop 'X' at PIN 411005.
wording.new: Signed in as an owner who already has shop 'X' at PIN 411005, live (a shop still waiting for its fee blocks any new registration — TC-ONB-078). The new registration uses another GSTIN / PAN.
wording.why: A waiting shop stops the new registration before this check; with the same GSTIN/PAN the PAN rule answers first (different message).

wording.old: “You have already registered a shop with this name at this PIN code.” (P2-D3)

This shop is already registered and live on GoKesari. If you're the owner and need to update details, log in to your account or contact support.” (the second sentence follows shop 'X''s status) and the Shop name field “You have already registered a shop with this name at this PIN code” (P2-D3). With the same GSTIN / PAN as 'X' the PAN rule matches first: “PAN number already registered (XXXXXX…). This shop is already registered and live on GoKesari. …”.
wording.why: The message is the field line plus the matched shop's status sentence; it is given on the shop step (saveDraftDetails).

wording.old: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop.
wording.new: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop, on “Contact and shop details” (after Verify, the address and the map pin).

wording.old: Food: “FSSAI … is mandatory for this type of shop. Your shop can go live now, and you have a grace period of 90 days to upload it. Otherwise, your shop will be suspended.” Pharmacy: Drug licence. Clinics: Medical registration. Professional office: Bar Council / ICAI / ICSI. General store: no notice. Go-live is never blocked.
wording.new: Food: “FSSAI licence is mandatory for this type of shop. Your shop can go live now, and you have a grace period of 90 days to upload it. Otherwise, your shop will be suspended.” Pharmacy: the same with “Drug licence”. Clinics: “Medical registration”. Professional office: “Professional registration (Bar Council, ICAI or ICSI)”. General Trading Store: no notice. (90 = rule shopDocumentFollowUp.graceDays.) Go-live is never blocked.

wording.new: E-mail (and in-app notice) “Upload your licence within 90 days — <shop>”: “<the shop-type notice of TC-ONB-080> Please upload it on GoKesari by <date>. We will remind you every 15 days until then.”, <date> = the go-live (approval) date in IST + 90 days, e.g. “18 Feb 2027”.
wording.why: Adds the body and the date format the template sends.

wording.old: A food shop in grace. The follow-up runs at 05.00 IST on the 1st and the 15th (trigger the cron by hand on staging if needed).
wording.new: A wizard shop in grace (live, licence not uploaded). The follow-up is part of the 05.00 IST daily cron and acts only on the rule's reminder days (shopDocumentFollowUp.reminderDaysOfMonth: the 1st and the 15th); a hand-triggered POST /api/cron/daily on another day does nothing for it.
wording.why: Triggering the cron by hand on another day is a no-op for the follow-up.

2. Read the reminder
3. Upload the licence
4. Trigger the next run

2. Read the reminder
3. Upload the licence and the Shop Act certificate
4. Trigger the next run

possibleDefects.summary: GSTIN verified but the PAN inside it refused by the government (FAILED / EXPIRED, e.g. inactive): canContinue is false, so the owner stays on “Verify your business”, which shows the GSTIN with the badge “Verified”, no Continue button and no reason — the PAN's message is only shown as a notice on the next step, which is never reached. Found by reading the code; not reproducible with the local mock (it answers the GSTIN and its PAN by the same digits).

Minor: the identity screen's example numbers are ones the server refuses — “27ABCDE1234F1Z5” (in the format message and placeholder) has the wrong check character (0 is right, as in the server's own “27ABCDE1234F1Z0”) and its PAN part, like the PAN example “ABCDE1234F”, has D as 4th letter, which is not a PAN holder type.
Minor wording: in the wizard the photo reader's button says “These numbers are right — check them online”, but it only fills the number field; nothing is checked until Verify GSTIN / Verify PAN.

A food-type wizard shop paid without an FSSAI licence does not go live (contradicts DI-14 'licences never block go-live, FSSAI included'): the instant approval calls approveShopTransaction, which runs assertFssaiAllowsApproval with no wizard exemption; with rule documentUpload.fssaiMandatoryForFood at its default (true) it throws 'A shop that sells food needs a valid FSSAI licence…', the decision is logged PENDING and the shop stays PENDING_APPROVAL (owner sees 'Payment received — pending admin approval'); the grace e-mail (TC-ONB-081) and SC-39 never happen. Legal documents are exempted for wizard shops (legal-documents.ts:351-352) but FSSAI is not. The integration test 'a food shop goes live without its FSSAI … (DI-14)' passes only because tests/helpers/fixtures.ts switches fssaiMandatoryForFood off for every integration test. Note docs/decision-log.md DI-13 still says 'FSSAI for a food shop still applies' — the two decisions conflict; confirm with the owner, and check whether staging/production override documentUpload.fssaiMandatoryForFood (not queryable from here). Affects TC-ONB-080, TC-ONB-081, TC-ONB-082/083 for food shops, SC-39.
Barcode scanner: a typed code of fewer than 6 digits gets no feedback — 'Find' silently does nothing; the API's 'Enter the barcode number (at least 6 digits).' is never shown on the page (low, UX).

Unknown barcode: the owner is told 'it goes on sale in your shop once approved', but the listing created with the pending product is not held back by approval — customers' catalogue (storefrontConditions) has no approval check, so once the owner gives it stock (My products) it is Live and orderable before the team approves it. Either the message or the gate is wrong (owner Q9: 'a new product for our team to approve').

Admin → Rider payouts “Run now”: whenever a run carries any rider forward, the success message shows only that count (e.g. “1”) instead of “N payment(s) created, M carried forward.” — the run result's `skipped` is a number on success, but the button treats any truthy `skipped` as the “not started” reason text.

The rider's payout statement always shows “Paid to your bank ₹X” — also for a refused withdrawal (“Failed — back in balance”) or a failed/reversed monthly payout, where nothing reached the bank (low; misleading wording).

A composition shop (and an Enrolment-ID shop) can issue a counter bill / B2B sales invoice or a POS bill to a buyer in another state: Accounts > Sales and the POS never apply the tax engine's supplyBlock; only marketplace checkout refuses the inter-state supply (rule billing.compositionInterStateAllowed false: 'law: no, for goods'). The bill is issued as a bill of supply.
possibleDefects.evidence: src/server/accounts/sales.ts:88-115 (issueSalesInvoice: no supplyBlock); src/server/accounts/pos.ts:86-104; compare src/server/tax/checkout.ts:38-55 and src/server/config/rules.ts:1700,1731
